newsitem.title: CANADA: Domco to offer C$36.94 mln of units.
newsitem.headline: Domco to offer C$36.94 mln of units.

text.p: Domco Inc said on Thursday that its board of directors approved the filing of a final prospectus for the secondary offering of 3,358,200 units at C$11 each.
Each unit consists of one common share and one-half of a common share purchase warrant. Each whole warrant entitles the holder to acquire a common share at C$11 by November 6, 1998.

The net proceeds of the offering are estimated at C$21 million and will be used to reduce long-term debt. The debt repayment and cash flow would allow the company to invest about C$33 million over the next two years to automate certain production processes, improve productivity and increase capacity in all its production facilities, it said.
In addition, US$9.9 million will be used to purchase the remaining 7.4 percent non-controliing interst in Domco USA, which holds the company's interest in its U.S.-based operations.

As part of the offering, two European shareholders, Linor S.A. and Sergio Serralunga, will sell 1,358,200 common shares and Lonor S.A. will pledge 220,000 common shares for transfer on the exercise of the warrants.
The secondary portion of the offering is estimated at C$13.9 million. After the offering and assuming the exercise of the warrants, Linor will hold about 3.8 percent of the company's common shares.

The equity interest in Domco held by the company's principal shareholder, Sommer Allibert, will decline to about 70 percent from 80.2 percent after the offering, or 57.8 percent on a fully diluted basis, assuming exercise of the warrants.
